item.title: Elevated errors affecting the Microsoft 365 connector
item.description:
Nov 13, 21:49 UTC
Resolved - This incident has been resolved. From 08:03 PT / 16:03 UTC on November 12 to 08:40 PT / 16:40 UTC on November 13, mail, calendar and search tools in the Microsoft 365 connector and Claude for Outlook returned errors for many requests because of a Microsoft 365 service incident. Microsoft is still completing its recovery, so you may see occasional errors or delays.

Nov 13, 15:40 UTC
Monitoring - We're seeing signs of recovery for the Microsoft 365 connector. Claude for Outlook is also recovering. Some SharePoint search requests are still returning errors. Microsoft's incident remains open, so errors may return. We're continuing to monitor and will update this post as soon as we have more info.

Nov 12, 22:23 UTC
Update - This issue is caused by a Microsoft 365 service incident, and mail, calendar and search tools in the Microsoft 365 connector are still failing for most requests. Claude for Outlook remains affected. You can follow Microsoft's progress at https://status.cloud.microsoft. We will update this post when service is restored.

Nov 12, 21:18 UTC
Update - We are continuing to work with our upstream provider, who is restarting affected servers. Mail, calendar and search tools in the Microsoft 365 connector are still failing for most requests, and Claude for Outlook remains affected. We will provide another update as soon as we have more information.

Nov 12, 20:28 UTC
Update - We are continuing to work with our upstream provider on this issue. Mail, calendar and search tools in the Microsoft 365 connector are still failing for most requests. Claude for Outlook is also affected: mail and calendar actions may fail, and some users may not be able to open the add-in. We will provide another update within the hour.

Nov 12, 18:34 UTC
Identified - We have identified an issue with an upstream provider affecting the Microsoft 365 connector. Mail, calendar and search tools are failing for most requests, and new connections to the connector may not complete. We are in contact with them and will provide an update as soon as possible.

Nov 12, 17:52 UTC
Investigating - We are investigating elevated errors and slow responses affecting the Microsoft 365 connector. Requests to mail, SharePoint, Teams chat and calendar through the connector may fail, and new connections to the connector may not complete. We will provide an update as soon as possible.

item.title: Elevated errors on claude.ai, the Claude API, and Claude Code
item.description:
Nov 13, 15:38 UTC
Resolved - The issue affecting multiple surfaces has been resolved.

Nov 13, 15:33 UTC
Monitoring - Errors on claude.ai, including the mobile apps, the Claude API and Claude Code have returned to normal levels, and we are continuing to monitor. Existing connectors, including Docs and Sheets, are working again, and Claude Managed Agents and Claude Meetings are recovering. Adding a new connector on claude.ai is temporarily unavailable. Scheduled tasks and routines can run more than two hours late and some runs have been skipped, and Claude Security scans, reviews and project setup remain delayed. We'll share another update soon.

Nov 13, 14:36 UTC
Update - We're seeing recovery on claude.ai and the Claude API, though errors may return while we continue working on this. Connectors, including Docs and Sheets, remain degraded, as do Claude in Meetings, Claude Managed Agents, Claude Security and connector use in Claude Code. Mobile apps are affected in the same way as claude.ai. We'll share another update soon.

Nov 13, 14:03 UTC
Update - We are investigating reports of degraded performance affecting a variety of surfaces including claude.ai, the Claude API, Claude Code, connectors (including Claude Docs and Claude Sheets), Claude Security and Claude Managed Agents.

Nov 13, 13:52 UTC
Update - We are investigating reports of degraded performance affecting claude.ai, the Claude API, Claude Code, and connectors (including Claude Docs and Claude Sheets).

Nov 13, 13:09 UTC
Investigating - We are investigating reports of degraded performance affecting claude.ai, the Claude API, and Claude Code. We will provide an update as soon as possible.
